title: Shaharda yo‘l so‘rash va tushuntirish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida shahar joylarining nomlarini aytasiz, yo‘l so‘raysiz va berasiz, chap/o‘ngga burilish, to‘g‘ri yurish, “tashqari/yonimda” va “keyin” kabi joylashuv so‘zlarini ishlatasiz va buyruq shaklida yo‘l ko‘rsatishingiz mumkin bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: O‘n birinchi dars: shaharda yo‘l
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘n birinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan darsda uy, xonalar va jihozlarni o‘rgandik. Bugun shaharda yo‘l so‘rash va berishni o‘rganamiz: joylarning nomlari, chap-o‘ngga burilish, to‘g‘ri yurish, “tashqari” va “yanada”, hamda buyruq shaklida yo‘l ko‘rsatish. Dars oxirida uyingizdan yaqin do‘konga yo‘l ko‘rsatishingiz mumkin bo‘ladi. Boshlaymiz.
scenes.say: Welcome to lesson eleven. Today we ask for and give directions in the city.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n birinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Bugun shaharda yo‘l so‘rash va berishni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Shahar joylarining nomlari
scenes.say_native: Avval shahar joylari. “As-sūqu” — bozor, “al-madrasatu” — maktab, “al-masjidu” — masjid, “al-funduqu” — mehmonxona. Bu so‘zlar barcha “al” bilan aniq, chunki shaharda aniq joylar. “Al-masjidu” da “s” quyosh harfi, shuning uchun “al-masjidu” emas, “as-masjidu” deymiz, “l” “s” ga qo‘shilib ketadi. “Al-funduqu” da “l” saqlanadi, chunki “f” oy harfi. Bu farqni qulog‘ingiz bilan ilg‘ang.
scenes.say: As-suq, al-madrasa, as-masjid, al-funduq. Market, school, mosque, hotel.
scenes.say_uz: As-suq, al-madrasa, as-masjid, al-funduq. Bozor, maktab, masjid, mehmonxona.

scenes.title: Yana joylar
scenes.say_native: Yana to‘rtta joy. “Al-maṭʿamu” — restoran, “al-bānku” — bank, “al-ḥadīqatu” — bog‘, “al-jāmiʿatu” — universitet. “Al-bānku” da “l” saqlanadi, chunki “b” oy harfi. “Al-ḥadīqatu” da “l” “ḥ” ga saqlanadi, chunki “ḥ” oy harfi. “Al-jāmiʿatu” da “l” “j” ga saqlanadi. “Al-maṭʿamu” — restoran. Bu joylarni yaxshi yodlab oling, ular yo‘l berishda kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Al-matam, al-bank, al-hadiqa, al-jamia. Restaurant, bank, park, university.
scenes.say_uz: Al-maṭʿam, al-bank, al-ḥadīqa, al-jāmiʿa. Restoran, bank, bog‘, universitet.

scenes.title: Joy nomlang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Beshta joyni arabcha ayting: bozor, maktab, masjid, mehmonxona, restoran. Quyosh harflarda “l” ni qo‘shlab ketishni unutmang.
scenes.say: Say the Arabic words for market, school, mosque, hotel and restaurant.
scenes.say_uz: Arabcha ayting: bozor, maktab, masjid, mehmonxona, restoran.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: as-sūqu. Al-madrasatu. As-masjidu. Al-funduqu. Al-maṭʿamu. Birinchi va uchinchida “l” “s” ga qo‘shilib ketadi: as-sūq, as-masjid. Qolganlarida “l” saqlanadi. Endi yo‘l berish so‘zlarini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: As-suq, al-madrasa, as-masjid, al-funduq, al-matam.
scenes.say_uz: As-suq, al-madrasa, as-masjid, al-funduq, al-maṭʿam.

scenes.title: Yo‘l berish: chap, o‘ng, to‘g‘ri
scenes.say_native: Yo‘l berish uchun buyruq shakli (imperativ) ishlatiladi. “In‘akif ilā al-yamīn” — o‘ngga buril. “In‘akif ilā al-shimāl” — chapga buril. “Adhhab mustaqīman” — to‘g‘ri yur. “Ishburī al-shāriʿa” — ko‘chaga o‘t. “Al-yamīn” — o‘ng, “al-shimāl” — chap. “Mustaqīman” — to‘g‘ri. Bu shakllar “anta” (siz) uchun buyruq, shuning uchun ungina biror bir narsa buyirmoqchi bo‘lsangiz ishlatiladi. “Ilā” — ga, tomon. “Al-yamīn” da “l” saqlanadi, chunki “y” oy harfi.
scenes.say: In‘akif ila al-yamin, in‘akif ila al-shimal, adhhab mustaqiman. Turn right, turn left, go straight.
scenes.say_uz: In‘akif ila al-yamin o‘ngga, in‘akif ila al-shimal chapga, adhhab mustaqiman to‘g‘ri yur.

scenes.title: Buyruq shaklli
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta buyruqni arabcha ayting. Birinchi: o‘ngga buril. Ikkinchi: chapga buril. Uchinchi: to‘g‘ri yur. To‘rtinchi: ko‘chaga o‘t. Buyruq shaklini ishlating.
scenes.say: Turn right. Turn left. Go straight. Cross the street.
scenes.say_uz: O‘ngga buril. Chapga buril. To‘g‘ri yur. Ko‘chaga o‘t.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: in‘akif ilā al-yamīn. In‘akif ilā al-shimāl. Adhhab mustaqīman. Ishburī al-shāriʿa. Ushbu buyruq shakllar “siz” (erkak yoki umuman) uchun. “Ishburī” da “sh” quyosh harfi, shuning uchun “al-shāriʿa”. Endi joylashuv so‘zlarini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Turn right. Turn left. Go straight. Cross the street.
scenes.say_uz: O‘ngga buril. Chapga buril. To‘g‘ri yur. Ko‘chaga o‘t.

scenes.title: Joylashuv: tashqari, yanada, yaqin
scenes.say_native: Joylashuv so‘zlari: “muqābalan” — tashqari/munosib, “bijānibi” — yanada, “qarībā” — yaqin, “baʿīdan” — qanqar. “Al-masjidu muqābalan as-sūq” — masjid bozorga tashqari. “Al-funduqu bijānibi al-madrasati” — mehmonxona maktabning yanada. “Bijānibi” va “muqābalan” dan keyingi ot majrūr bo‘ladi: as-sūq, al-madrasati. “Qarībā” — yaqin, “baʿīdan” — far. Bu so‘zlar yo‘l berishda juda muhim.
scenes.say: Muqabalan, bijanibi, qariban, baidan. Opposite, next to, near, far.
scenes.say_uz: Muqabalan tashqari, bijanibi yanada, qariban yaqin, baidan qanqar.

scenes.title: Joylashuvni ayting
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta gapni arabcha ayting. Birinchi: masjid bozorga tashqari. Ikkinchi: mehmonxona maktabning yanada. Uchinchi: bazar yaqin. To‘rtinchi: bank qanqar. “Muqābalan” va “bijānibi” ni to‘g‘ri ishlating.
scenes.say: The mosque is opposite the market. The hotel is next to the school. The market is near. The bank is far.
scenes.say_uz: Masjid bozorga tashqari. Mehmonxona maktabning yanada. Bazar yaqin. Bank qanqar.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: al-masjidu muqābalan as-sūq. Al-funduqu bijānibi al-madrasati. As-sūqu qarībā. Al-bānku baʿīdan. To‘rtinchida “al-bānku” — bank, “l” saqlanadi, chunki “b” oy harfi. Endi savol berishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: The mosque is opposite the market. The hotel is next to the school. The market is near. The bank is far.
scenes.say_uz: Masjid bozorga tashqari. Mehmonxona maktabning yanada. Bazar yaqin. Bank qanqar.

scenes.title: Savol berish: ayna, hal
scenes.say_native: “Qayerda?” — “ayna”. “Ayna al-funduqu?” — mehmonxona qayerda? “Ayna as-sūqu?” — bozor qayerda? “Hal taʿrifu ...?” — ... ni bilasizmi? Savol berish uchun “ayna” joyni, “hal” ha/yo‘qni so‘raydi. “Hal taʿrifu al-funduqa?” — mehmonxonani bilasizmi? Javob: “naʿam, aʿrifu” — ha, bilaman, yoki “lā, lā aʿrifu” — yo‘q, bilmayman. Endi yo‘l so‘rashni birga ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: Ayna al-funduq? Where is the hotel? Hal ta'rifu? Do you know?
scenes.say_uz: Ayna al-funduq? Mehmonxona qayerda? Hal ta'rifu? Bilasizmi?

scenes.title: Yo‘l so‘rash xatosi
scenes.say_native: Ikki nozik nuqta. Birinchisi: “anta ayna al-funduqu?” — “siz” qo‘shilmasligi kerak, chunki “ayna” allaqachon savol so‘zi. “Ayna al-funduqu?” to‘g‘ri. Ikkinchisi: “hal al-funduqu hunāka?” — bank/mehmonxona u yerda? Bu to‘g‘ri, lekin oddiy. Yo‘l so‘rashda “ayna” aniqroq. “Anta” qo‘shilganda gap o‘chadi. “Ayna” savol boshida turadi.
scenes.say: Say ayna al-funduq, not anta ayna al-funduq.
scenes.say_uz: Ayna al-funduq deng, anta ayna al-funduq emas.

scenes.title: Yo‘l so‘rang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta joyni so‘rang: mehmonxona, bozor, universitet, hammom. Har birida “ayna” bilan boshlang. “Ayna al-funduqu?”, “Ayna as-sūqu?”, “Ayna al-jāmiʿatu?”, “Ayna al-ḥammāmu?”.
scenes.say: Where is the hotel? Where is the market? Where is the university? Where is the bathroom?
scenes.say_uz: Mehmonxona qayerda? Bozor qayerda? Universitet qayerda? Hammom qayerda?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: ayna al-funduqu? Ayna as-sūqu? Ayna al-jāmiʿatu? Ayna al-ḥammāmu? “Al-ḥammāmu” da “l” “ḥ” ga saqlanadi, chunki “ḥ” oy harfi. Endi javob berishni, ya‘ni yo‘l berishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Where is the hotel? Where is the market? Where is the university? Where is the bathroom?
scenes.say_uz: Mehmonxona qayerda? Bozor qayerda? Universitet qayerda? Hammom qayerda?

scenes.title: Yo‘l berish: namuna
board: اذْهَبْ مُسْتَقِيمًا، ثُمَّ انْعَكِفْ إلى الْيَمِينِ.
scenes.say_native: Yo‘l berish namuna. “Adhhab mustaqīman, thumma in‘akif ilā al-yamīn” — to‘g‘ri yur, keyin o‘ngga buril. “Al-funduqu bijānibi al-masjidi” — mehmonxona masjidning yanada. “Hunāka” — u yerda. “Thumma” — keyin, so‘ng. Bu to‘liq yo‘l ko‘rsatish. Endi o‘zingiz yo‘l ko‘rsatishingiz mumkin.
scenes.say: Go straight, then turn right. The hotel is next to the mosque. There.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri yur, keyin o‘ngga buril. Mehmonxona masjidning yanada. U yerda.

scenes.title: Yo‘l bering
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta yo‘lni arabcha bering. Birinchi: to‘g‘ri yur, keyin chapga buril. Ikkinchi: bozor masjidning yanada. Uchinchi: mehmonxona u yerda. To‘rtinchi: ko‘chaga o‘t, keyin o‘ngga buril. Buyruq shakl va joylashuv so‘zini ishlating.
scenes.say: Go straight, then turn left. The market is next to the mosque. The hotel is there. Cross the street, then turn right.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri yur, keyin chapga buril. Bozor masjidning yanada. Mehmonxona u yerda. Ko‘chaga o‘t, keyin o‘ngga buril.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: اذْهَبْ مُسْتَقِيمًا، ثُمَّ انْعَكِفْ إلى الشِّمَالِ.
اعْبُرِ الشَّارِعَ، ثُمَّ انْعَكِفْ إلى الْيَمِينِ.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: adhhab mustaqīman, thumma in‘akif ilā al-shimāl. As-sūqu bijānibi al-masjidi. Al-funduqu hunāka. Ishburī al-shāriʿa, thumma in‘akif ilā al-yamīn. Uchinchida “hunāka” — u yerda. To‘rtinchida “al-shāriʿa” — ko‘cha, “l” “sh” ga qo‘shilib ketadi. Endi dialog ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: Go straight, then turn left. The market is next to the mosque. The hotel is there. Cross the street, then turn right.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri yur, keyin chapga buril. Bozor masjidning yanada. Mehmonxona u yerda. Ko‘chaga o‘t, keyin o‘ngga buril.

scenes.title: Birinchi dialog: bozorga yo‘l
board: سَامِي: اذْهَبْ مُسْتَقِيمًا، ثُمَّ انْعَكِفْ إلى الْيَمِينِ. السُّوقُ بِجَانِبِ الْمَسْجِدِ.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog. Ahmad “ayna as-sūqu, min faḍlika?” — bozor qayerda, iltimos? deb so‘raydi. Sami “adhhab mustaqīman, thumma in‘akif ilā al-yamīn. As-sūqu bijānibi al-masjidi” — to‘g‘ri yur, keyin o‘ngga buril. Bozor masjidning yanada. — deb javob beradi. Ahmad “shukran” — rahmat. Sami “ahlan, afwan” — xush kelibsiz, rica eting. Bu to‘liq yo‘l so‘rash va berish jarayoni.
scenes.say: Where is the market, please? Go straight, then turn right. The market is next to the mosque. Thank you. You are welcome.
scenes.say_uz: Bozor qayerda, iltimos? To‘g‘ri yur, keyin o‘ngga buril. Bozor masjidning yanada. Rahmat. Xush kelibsiz.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Birinchi: Ahmad nima so‘rayapti? Ikkinchi: Sami qanday yo‘l beradi? Uchinchi: bozor qayerda? To‘rtinchi: Ahmad nima deyadi? Dialogdan javob bering.
scenes.say: What is Ahmad asking? What directions does Sami give? Where is the market? What does Ahmad say?
scenes.say_uz: Ahmad nima so‘rayapti? Sami qanday yo‘l beradi? Bozor qayerda? Ahmad nima deyadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) اذْهَبْ مُسْتَقِيمًا، ثُمَّ انْعَكِفْ إلى الْيَمِينِ
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Ahmad as-sūqni so‘rayapti — bozorni so‘rayapti. Sami “adhhab mustaqīman, thumma in‘akif ilā al-yamīn” deb yo‘l beradi. Bozor “bijānibi al-masjidi” — masjidning yanada. Ahmad “shukran” dedi — rahmat. Endi o‘zingizning uyingizdan yaqin do‘konga yo‘l ko‘rsataymiz.
scenes.say: The market. Go straight, then turn right. Next to the mosque. Thank you.
scenes.say_uz: Bozor. To‘g‘ri yur, keyin o‘ngga buril. Masjidning yanada. Rahmat.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: buyruq shaklli
scenes.say_native: Buyruq shaklli talaffuz. “In‘akif” — in-‘a-kif, hamza bor, aniq. “Adhhab” — adh-hab, “dh” yumshoq. “Ishburī” — ish-bur, “sh” aniq. “Mustaqīman” — mus-ta-qii-man, uzun “ī”. Har birini ikki marta baland ovozda takrorlang. Buyruq shaklli tez va aniq bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: In‘akif, adhhab, ishburi, mustaqiman.
scenes.say_uz: In‘akif, adhhab, ishburi, mustaqiman.

scenes.title: Baland ovozda takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta iborani baland ovozda takrorlang. Birinchi: o‘ngga buril. Ikkinchi: to‘g‘ri yur. Uchinchi: ko‘chaga o‘t. To‘rtinchi: tashqari / yanada. Har birini ikki marta ayting.
scenes.say: Repeat: turn right. Go straight. Cross the street. Opposite / next to.
scenes.say_uz: Takrorlang: o‘ngga buril. To‘g‘ri yur. Ko‘chaga o‘t. Tashqari / yanada.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar to‘g‘ri. “In‘akif ilā al-yamīn”, “adhhab mustaqīman”, “ishburī al-shāriʿa”, “muqābalan / bijānibi”. Endi o‘zingizning uyingizdan yaqin do‘konga yo‘l ko‘rsatishingiz mumkin.
scenes.say: Turn right. Go straight. Cross the street. Opposite / next to.
scenes.say_uz: O‘ngga buril. To‘g‘ri yur. Ko‘chaga o‘t. Tashqari / yanada.

scenes.title: Yana shahar joylari
scenes.say_native: Yana to‘rtta joy. “Al-bānku” — bank, “al-ḥadīqatu” — bog‘, “al-mustashfa” — kasalxona, “ṣaydalīyah” — dorixona. “Al-mustashfa” — kasalxona, “l” saqlanadi, chunki “m” oy harfi. “Ṣaydalīyah” — dorixona, ayol jinsli ta marbuta bilan. “Al-bānku” — bank, erkak. Endi bu joylarni yana bir marta takrorlaymiz.
scenes.say: Al-bank, al-hadiqa, al-mustashfa, saydaliya.
scenes.say_uz: Al-bank, al-ḥadīqa, al-mustashfa, ṣaydalīya.

scenes.title: Yana joylar
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Beshta joyni arabcha ayting: bank, bog‘, kasalxona, dorixona, pochtakhona. “Pochtakhona” — “barīd”. Har birini baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Say bank, park, hospital, pharmacy and post office.
scenes.say_uz: Arabcha ayting: bank, bog‘, kasalxona, dorixona, pochtakhona.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: al-bānku. Al-ḥadīqatu. Al-mustashfa. Ṣaydalīyah. Al-barīdu — pochtakhona. “Al-barīdu” da “l” “b” ga saqlanadi, oy harf. Bu beshta joyni yaxshi yodlab oling. Endi “iltimos” va “kechirasiz” ni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Bank, park, hospital, pharmacy, post office.
scenes.say_uz: Bank, bog‘, kasalxona, dorixona, pochtakhona.

scenes.title: Iltimos va kechirasiz
scenes.say_native: Yo‘l so‘rashda adabiyot muhim. “Min faḍlika” — iltimos, erkakka. “Min faḍhliki” — iltimos, ayolga. “Law samḥta” — kechirasiz/iltimos, ertaksi. “Afwan” — xush kelibsiz/rica eting. “Law samḥta, ayna al-ṣaydalīyah?” — kechirasiz, dorixona qayerda? Bu shakllar suhbatni nozik qiladi. “Faḍlika” va “faḍhliki” farqi suhbatdoshning jinsida.
scenes.say: Min fadlika, min fadhliki, law samih ta, afwan.
scenes.say_uz: Min fadlika erkakka, min fadhliki ayolga. Law samihta kechirasiz. Afwan xush kelibsiz.

scenes.title: Iltimos va kechirasiz
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta gapni arabcha ayting. Birinchi: erkakka murojaat qilib, kechirasiz, dorixona qayerda? Ikkinchi: ayolga murojaat qilib, iltimos, bozor qayerda? Uchinchi: xush kelibsiz. To‘rtinchi: rica eting. “Min faḍlika” va “min faḍhliki” ni to‘g‘ri tanlang.
scenes.say: Excuse me, where is the pharmacy? Please, where is the market? You are welcome.
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, dorixona qayerda? Iltimos, bozor qayerda? Xush kelibsiz.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: law samḥta, ayna al-ṣaydalīyah? Min faḍhliki, ayna as-sūqu? Afwan. Ahlan. Uchinchi va to‘rtinchida “afwan” va “ahlan” — sotuvchi va mehmonga javob. “Ayna” savol boshida. Endi “o‘ng yon” va “chap yon” ni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Law samihta, ayna as saydaliya? Min fadhli ki, ayna as suq? Afwan. Ahlan.
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, dorixona qayerda? Iltimos, bozor qayerda? Afwan. Ahlan.

scenes.title: O‘ng va chap yon
scenes.say_native: “Fī al-yamīn” — o‘ngda, “fī al-shimāl” — chapda. “ʿAlā al-yamīn” — o‘ng tomondan, “ʿalā al-shimāl” — chap tomondan. “Fī” — ichida/da, “ʿalā” — ustida/tomondan. “Al-masjidu fī al-yamīn” — masjid o‘ngda. “As-sūqu ʿalā al-shimāl” — bozor chap tomonda. “Fī” va “ʿalā” dan keyingi ot majrūr bo‘ladi. Endi bu so‘zlarni yo‘l berishda ishlatamiz.
scenes.say: Fi al-yamin, fi al-shimal, ala al-yamin, ala al-shimal.
scenes.say_uz: Fi al-yamin o‘ngda. Fi al-shimal chapda. Ala al-yamin o‘ng tomondan. Ala al-shimal chap tomondan.

scenes.title: O‘ng va chap
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta gapni arabcha ayting. Birinchi: masjid o‘ngda. Ikkinchi: bozor chap tomonda. Uchinchi: bank o‘ng tomondan. To‘rtinchi: dorixona chapda. “Fī” va “ʿalā” ni to‘g‘ri ishlating.
scenes.say: The mosque is on the right. The market is on the left side. The bank is on the right side. The pharmacy is on the left.
scenes.say_uz: Masjid o‘ngda. Bozor chap tomonda. Bank o‘ng tomondan. Dorixona chapda.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: al-masjidu fī al-yamīn. As-sūqu ʿalā al-shimāl. Al-bānku ʿalā al-yamīn. Al-ṣaydalīyatu fī al-shimāl. “Al-ṣaydalīyatu” da “l” “ṣ” ga qo‘shilib ketadi, quyosh harf. “Al-bānku” da “l” saqlanadi. Endi “yaqin” va “qanqar” ni birga ishlatamiz.
scenes.say: The mosque is on the right. The market is on the left side. The bank is on the right side. The pharmacy is on the left.
scenes.say_uz: Masjid o‘ngda. Bozor chap tomonda. Bank o‘ng tomondan. Dorixona chapda.

scenes.title: Yo‘l berish mashqi
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta gapni arabcha ayting. Birinchi: kechirasiz, dorixona qayerda? Ikkinchi: to‘g‘ri yur, keyin chapga buril. Uchinchi: dorixona masjidning yanada. To‘rtinchi: rahmat, iltimos. Buyruq, joylashuv va adabiyotni birga ishlating.
scenes.say: Excuse me, where is the pharmacy? Go straight, then turn left. The pharmacy is next to the mosque. Thank you, please.
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, dorixona qayerda? To‘g‘ri yur, keyin chapga buril. Dorixona masjidning yanada. Rahmat, iltimos.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: اذْهَبْ مُسْتَقِيمًا، ثُمَّ انْعَكِفْ إلى الشِّمَالِ.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: law samḥta, ayna al-ṣaydalīyah? Adhhab mustaqīman, thumma in‘akif ilā al-shimāl. Al-ṣaydalīyatu bijānibi al-masjidi. Shukran, tafḍal. “Tafḍal” — iltimos/qayting, buyurtma yoki yo‘l berishda. Endi o‘zingizning uyingizdan dorixonaga yo‘l ko‘rsataymiz.
scenes.say: Excuse me, where is the pharmacy? Go straight, then turn left. The pharmacy is next to the mosque. Thank you, please.
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, dorixona qayerda? To‘g‘ri yur, keyin chapga buril. Dorixona masjidning yanada. Rahmat.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: dh va th
board: dh — yumshoq d, th — yumshoq t
scenes.say_native: “Dh” va “th” tovushlari. “Adhhab” — adh-hab, “dh” yumshoq d. “Thumma” — thum-ma, “th” yumshoq t. “Tarīq” — yo‘l, “t” oddiy. Bu tovushlar o‘zbek tilida yo‘q, shuning uchun mashq kerak. “Dh” — tilni tishlarga quyib, ovoz yumshoq. “Th” — tilni tishlariga chuqur yozib, havo chiqadi. Har birini ikki marta baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Adhhab, thumma, tariq.
scenes.say_uz: Adhhab, thumma, tariq.

scenes.title: Baland ovozda takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta iborani baland ovozda takrorlang. Birinchi: to‘g‘ri yur. Ikkinchi: keyin o‘ngga buril. Uchinchi: masjid bozoring yanada. To‘rtinchi: iltimos, bozor qayerda? Har birini ikki marta ayting.
scenes.say: Repeat: go straight. Then turn right. The mosque is next to the market. Excuse me, where is the market?
scenes.say_uz: Takrorlang: to‘g‘ri yur. Keyin o‘ngga buril. Masjid bozoring yanada. Iltimos, bozor qayerda?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar to‘g‘ri. “Adhhab mustaqīman”, “thumma in‘akif ilā al-yamīn”, “al-masjidu bijānibi as-sūq”, “law samḥta, ayna as-sūq?”. Endi o‘zingizning uyingizdan yaqin do‘konga yo‘l ko‘rsatishingiz mumkin.
scenes.say: Go straight. Then turn right. The mosque is next to the market. Excuse me, where is the market?
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri yur. Keyin o‘ngga buril. Masjid bozoring yanada. Iltimos, bozor qayerda?

scenes.title: Uyingizdan do‘konga yo‘l
scenes.say_native: Endi sizning navbatingiz. Uyingizdan yaqin bir do‘kon yoki bozorga yo‘l ko‘rsatng. Kamida 3-5 ta buyruq so‘zi (to‘g‘ri yur, chapga buril, o‘ngga buril, yanada, tashqari) ishlating. “Adhhab ... thumma in‘akif ...” shaklida gapiring. Sekin va aniq.
scenes.say: Give directions from your home to a nearby shop.
scenes.say_uz: Uyingizdan yaqin do‘konga yo‘l ko‘rsatng.

scenes.title: O‘z-o‘zini tekshirish
scenes.say_native: Tekshiring. Birinchi: buyruq shakli (adhhab, in‘akif) bormi? Ikkinchi: joylashuv so‘zi (bijānibi, muqābalan, fawqa) bormi? Uchinchi: “ayna” savoli bormi? To‘rtinchi: 3-5 ta buyruq aytdingizmi? Har biriga “ha” desangiz, vazifa bajarildi.
scenes.say: Check imperative, location words, ayna question and 3-5 directions.
scenes.say_uz: Buyruq shakli, joylashuv so‘zi, ayna savoli va 3-5 buyruqni tekshiring.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Shahar joylarini o‘rgandik: as-sūq, al-madrasa, as-masjid, al-funduq, al-maṭʿam, al-bank. Buyruq: in‘akif ilā al-yamīn, in‘akif ilā al-shimāl, adhhab mustaqīman. Joylashuv: muqābalan, bijānibi, qarībā, baʿīdan. Savol: “ayna”. Eng muhim fikr: buyruq shakli “siz” uchun, tez va aniq bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: City places, directions, turn right/left, go straight, opposite/next to, where questions.
scenes.say_uz: Shahar joylari, yo‘l berish, o‘ngga-chapga burilish, to‘g‘ri yurish, tashqari/yanada, ayna savoli.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi. Uyingizdan yaqin bir do‘kongacha yoki bozorgacha yo‘l ko‘rsatishni arabcha yozing va tarjima qiling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida 3-5 ta buyruq, bitta joylashuv so‘zi, “ayna” savoli va to‘g‘ri tarjima. Keyingi darsda ranglar, kiyim va do‘konda xaridni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Homework: give directions from your home to a nearby shop.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: uydan yaqin do‘konga yo‘l ko‘rsatng.

homework_uz: Uyingizdan yaqin bir do‘kongacha yoki bozorgacha yo‘l ko‘rsatishni arabcha yozing va tarjima qiling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida 3-5 ta buyruq, bitta joylashuv so‘zi, “ayna” savoli va to‘g‘ri tarjima.
